Camping status

Limits to confirm

Frequently asked questions

Is camping allowed at Pinus Pengger?

An official camping permit is unverified. Ask staff or the manager about camping, allowed areas and reservations.

Is tent rental available?

Tent rental availability is unverified; do not assume an on-site service.

Is it suitable for school groups?

Worth considering if coordinated, but ask the manager about capacity and permits first.

Are campfires allowed?

Campfire rules are unverified; do not assume allowed. Confirm before bringing equipment.
